task.problem:
After TASK-304 and TASK-305 were reviewed and published, the same real unresolved origin-affine H4D carrier advanced through listener absence proof, dedicated-profile occupancy proof, browser launch, exact OS owner proof, and one Playwright context, then deferred before page creation. Read-only diagnosis proved Target.getBrowserContexts returns a dictionary with browserContextIds=[] plus an optional non-empty defaultBrowserContextId. Current _prove_context() requires exact dictionary equality with only browserContextIds=[], so the valid production shape is rejected as BROWSER_CONTEXT_UNPROVEN. Additional read-only checks proved zero non-default contexts, one stable Playwright context before/after CDP session detach, bounded new_page bridge availability, acquisition-lock cleanup, canonical carrier freshness UNRESOLVED, exact origin-affinity match, and clean Playwright shutdown even with an open browser CDP session. The prior live retry surfaced LOCAL_FAILURE externally, so expected operational exceptions inside the bounded context/page bridge also require deterministic fail-closed classification rather than escaping as a generic local failure.

TASK-306 revision 1 subsequently entered PRIMARY RUN-306-001 and failed Runtime verification because two inert regression-harness expectations did not match the bounded bridge behavior. A later local recovery attempt, RUN-306-002, materialized source candidate e4f4a07344d3aa9d1a1b07c71c47ec200560e820 and passed the authored focused verification commands, but no canonical REPAIR authorization exists for RUN-306-001. Therefore that RUN cannot establish review-eligible correction lineage. Revision 2 authorizes a fresh PRIMARY implementation of the same H4D semantics. The prior candidate is only the Brain-selected desired source end-state; r2 requires fresh Runtime verification and fresh semantic review.
